```
function refreshHatchTimers(){ for(let i=0;i<2;i++){ const tray=deviceState.trays[i]||null; renderHatchTimer(i,tray); updateTrayMotionStatus(i,tray); updateTrayMainMoveMsg(i,tray); } }
function updateTopDrum(id,rawValue,decimals){ const drum=document.getElementById(id); if(!drum) return; const digits=drum.querySelectorAll('.d'); if(digits.length<3) return; const value = (rawValue==null || !Number.isFinite(rawValue)) ? '--.--' : Number(rawValue).toFixed(decimals); let [intPart, fracPart] = value.split('.'); if(intPart.length<2) intPart = intPart.padStart(2,' '); const chars = (intPart+fracPart).split(''); for(let i=0;i<digits.length;i++){ digits[i].textContent = chars[i]||' '; } }
function updateTopESP(s){ const temp=s.esp_internal_temp; const el=document.getElementById('espTempTop'); const dot=document.getElementById('espDot'); if(!el||!dot) return; if(temp!=null){ el.textContent=temp.toFixed(1)+'°C'; updateTopDrum('espTempDrum',temp,1); if(temp>65){ el.style.color='var(--hot)'; dot.className='dot err'; } else if(temp>55){ el.style.color='var(--yellow)'; dot.className='dot warn'; } else { el.style.color=''; dot.className='dot ok'; } } else { el.textContent='--°C'; el.style.color=''; dot.className='dot err'; updateTopDrum('espTempDrum',null,1); } }
function updateAlerts(s){ const alerts=[]; const t=s.temp_chamber, tgt=s.target_temp, hMin=isF(s.humidity_target_min)?s.humidity_target_min:45; if(isValidTemp(t)&&isF(tgt)&&Math.abs(t-tgt)>=1.5) alerts.push('Temperatura komory odbiega od celu o >= 1.5°C'); if(isValidTemp(t)&&t>=40.5) alerts.push('Ryzyko przegrzania komory (>= 40.5°C)'); if(isValidHumidity(s.humidity)&&s.humidity<hMin-5) alerts.push('Niska wilgotność (poniżej minimum)'); if(s.esp_internal_temp!=null&&s.esp_internal_temp>=65) alerts.push('Wysoka temperatura ESP (>= 65°C)'); alerts.filter(a=>!alertState.prev.has(a)).forEach(a=>logEvent('warn','Alarm: '+a)); [...alertState.prev].filter(a=>!alerts.includes(a)).forEach(a=>logEvent('ok','Alarm ustąpił: '+a)); alertState.prev=new Set(alerts); const box=document.getElementById('alerts-box'); if(!box) return; if(!alerts.length){ box.textContent='Brak aktywnych alarmów.'; box.className='metric-sub'; return; } box.innerHTML=alerts.map(a=>`<div style="color:var(--hot);margin:2px 0">• ${a}</div>`).join(''); box.className='metric-sub'; }

```

```
function refreshHatchTimers(){ for(let i=0;i<2;i++){ const tray=deviceState.trays[i]||null; renderHatchTimer(i); updateTrayMotionStatus(i,tray); updateTrayMainMoveMsg(i,tray); } }
function updateTopDrum(id,rawValue,decimals){ const drum=document.getElementById(id); if(!drum) return; const digits=drum.querySelectorAll('.d'); if(digits.length<3) return; const value = (rawValue==null || !Number.isFinite(rawValue)) ? '--.--' : Number(rawValue).toFixed(decimals); let [intPart, fracPart] = value.split('.'); intPart = intPart.padStart(2,' '); fracPart = (fracPart||' ').padEnd(1,' '); const chars = (intPart + fracPart).split(''); for(let i=0;i<digits.length;i++){ digits[i].textContent = chars[i]||' '; } }
function updateTopESP(s){ const temp=s.esp_internal_temp; const el=document.getElementById('espTempTop'); const dot=document.getElementById('espDot'); if(!el||!dot) return; updateTopDrum('espTempDrum', temp, 1); if(temp!=null){ el.textContent=temp.toFixed(1)+'°C'; if(temp>65){ el.style.color='var(--hot)'; dot.className='dot err'; } else if(temp>55){ el.style.color='var(--yellow)'; dot.className='dot warn'; } else { el.style.color=''; dot.className='dot ok'; } } else { el.textContent='--°C'; el.style.color=''; dot.className='dot err'; } }
function updateAlerts(s){ const alerts=[]; const t=s.temp_chamber, tgt=s.target_temp, hMin=isF(s.humidity_target_min)?s.humidity_target_min:45; if(isValidTemp(t)&&isF(tgt)&&Math.abs(t-tgt)>=1.5) alerts.push('Temperatura komory odbiega od celu o >= 1.5°C'); if(isValidTemp(t)&&t>=40.5) alerts.push('Ryzyko przegrzania komory (>= 40.5°C)'); if(isValidHumidity(s.humidity)&&s.humidity<hMin-5) alerts.push('Niska wilgotność (poniżej minimum)'); if(s.esp_internal_temp!=null&&s.esp_internal_temp>=65) alerts.push('Wysoka temperatura ESP (>= 65°C)'); alerts.filter(a=>!alertState.prev.has(a)).forEach(a=>logEvent('warn','Alarm: '+a)); [...alertState.prev].filter(a=>!alerts.includes(a)).forEach(a=>logEvent('ok','Alarm ustąpił: '+a)); alertState.prev=new Set(alerts); const box=document.getElementById('alerts-box'); if(!box) return; if(!alerts.length){ box.textContent='Brak aktywnych alarmów.'; box.className='metric-sub'; return; } box.innerHTML=alerts.map(a=>`<div style="color:var(--hot);margin:2px 0">• ${a}</div>`).join(''); box.className='metric-sub'; }
```

```
function updateTopESP(s){ const temp=s.esp_internal_temp; const el=document.getElementById('espTempTop'); const dot=document.getElementById('espDot'); updateTopDrum('espTempDrum', temp, 1); if(!el||!dot) return; if(temp!=null){ el.textContent=temp.toFixed(2)+'°C'; if(temp>65){ el.style.color='var(--hot)'; dot.className='dot err'; } else if(temp>55){ el.style.color='var(--yellow)'; dot.className='dot warn'; } else { el.style.color=''; dot.className='dot ok'; } } else { el.textContent='--°C'; el.style.color=''; dot.className='dot err'; } }
function updateAlerts(s){ const alerts=[]; const t=s.temp_chamber, tgt=s.target_temp, hMin=isF(s.humidity_target_min)?s.humidity_target_min:45; if(isValidTemp(t)&&isF(tgt)&&Math.abs(t-tgt)>=1.5) alerts.push('Temperatura komory odbiega od celu o >= 1.5°C'); if(isValidTemp(t)&&t>=40.5) alerts.push('Ryzyko przegrzania komory (>= 40.5°C)'); if(isValidHumidity(s.humidity)&&s.humidity<hMin-5) alerts.push('Niska wilgotność (poniżej minimum)'); if(s.esp_internal_temp!=null&&s.esp_internal_temp>=65) alerts.push('Wysoka temperatura ESP (>= 65°C)'); alerts.filter(a=>!alertState.prev.has(a)).forEach(a=>logEvent('warn','Alarm: '+a)); [...alertState.prev].filter(a=>!alerts.includes(a)).forEach(a=>logEvent('ok','Alarm ustąpił: '+a)); alertState.prev=new Set(alerts); const box=document.getElementById('alerts-box'); if(!box) return; if(!alerts.length){ box.textContent='Brak aktywnych alarmów.'; box.className='metric-sub'; return; } box.innerHTML=alerts.map(a=>`<div style="color:var(--hot);margin:2px 0">• ${a}</div>`).join(''); box.className='metric-sub'; }
```

## Done

Updated the topbar in both UI files so the live values now use drum-style counters instead of plain text.

### Changes made
- `index.html`
  - Added drum-style topbar display for:
    - `ESP` (`espTempDrum`)
    - `RH` (`humDrum`)
    - `CHAM` / chamber temp (`chamberTempDrum`)
  - Wired `updateTopESP()` to update the ESP drum
  - Wired `updateTopTemps()` to update chamber temp and humidity drums
  - Added drum status styling classes `.topbar-drum.ok`, `.topbar-drum.warn`, `.topbar-drum.err`

- `index.html`
  - Added the same drum-style topbar display for ESP, humidity, and chamber temp
  - Updated `updateTopESP()` and `updateTopTemps()` accordingly
  - Added drum status styling classes

### Result
- Topbar now shows rotating drum-like numeric elements for ESP temperature, humidity, and chamber temperature
- Old plain text ESP/chamber values were removed from the visible topbar path
- Target temperature still displays as subtext `/ --°C` and updates normally

If you want, I can also make the drum labels fully symbolic (e.g. `°C`, `%`) and remove the remaining text labels entirely.
